items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to establishing an experiential
learning degree requirement in the state university of New York and the city
university of New York
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7808

SPONSOR: STAVISKY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the education law, in relation to establishing an exper-
iential learning degree requirement in the state university of New York
and the city university of New York

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

Requires the state university of New York board of trustees and the city
.university of New York board of trustees to develop a plan requiring
all .students in a degree program to complete an experiential or applied
learning activity.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1 discusses legislative findings and intent. States that exper-
iential learning may include service-learning activities, paid or unpaid
internships, ,research projects, and other programs that allow students
to develop work experience and practical skills necessary for life after
college.

Section 2 amends section 355 of the education law by requiring the SUNY
board of trustees to develop a plan that requires all students enrolled
in degree programs to participate in an experiential or applied learning
activity. This section also outlines what should be included in the plan
and allows a waiver process to be introduced which would allow a student
to apply for exemption from the requirement due to financial hardship or
extraordinary circumstances. Additionally, this section requires the
SUNY board of trustees to submit a written report detailing the plan.

Section 3 amends section 6206 of the education law by requiring the CUNY
board of trustees to develop a plan that requires all students enrolled
in degree programs to participate in an experiential or applied learning
activity. This section also outlines what should be included in the plan
and allows a waiver process to be introduced which would allow a student
to apply for exemption from the requirement due to financial hardship or
extraordinary circumstances.  Additionally, this section requires the
CUNY board of trustees to submit a written report detailing the plan.

Section 4 sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation is necessary to ensure all SUNY and CUNY students can
participate in experiential learning to enhance their education and
prepare them for careers after college. This requirement will allow all
students to develop practical skills and gain work experience, especial-
ly those students, who did not previously have access to:experiential
learning programs. These' programs help students develop necessary
skills and gain insight into how to begin building a career. For
instance, students who participate in internships are 15i less likely to
be unemployed in the first years after, graduating college and earn 6v=
more than students who did not have an internship.

Experiential and applied learning programs allow students to learn prob-
lem solving skills and gain real world knowledge of what work after
college may be like. These programs also provide students with an oppor-
tunity to begin to develop their personal and professional identities
through reflection and analysis of their experiences with their peers
and instructors.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATION:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

A.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to establishing experiential
learning opportunities in the state university of New York and the city
university of New York
A.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7808A

SPONSOR: STAVISKY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the education law, in relation to establishing experien-
tial learning opportunities in the state university of New York and the
city university of New York

 
PURPOSE:

Direct the state university of New York board of trustees and the city
university of New York board of trustees to develop a plan relating to
experiential learning opportunities for students.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: directs the state university of New York board of trustees to
develop a plan by June 1, 2025 to be made available to students enrolled
in the academic year 2025-2026 that defines approved experiential learn-
ing activities and considers the feasibility of implementing an exper-
iential learning degree requirement.

Section 2: directs the city university of New York board of trustees to
develop a plan by June 1, 2025 to be made available to students enrolled
in the academic year 2025-2026 that defines approved experiential learn-
ing activities and considers the feasibility of implementing an exper-
iential learning degree requirement.

Section 3: sets forth the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Experiential learning encompasses service-learning activities, paid or
unpaid internships, research projects, and other programs that allow
students to apply their knowledge outside of the classroom. By building
work experience and connections, experiential learning helps students
obtain job opportunities in New York State after college - according to
research by the National Association of Colleges and Employers (NACE),
72% of paid interns receive return offers for full-time employment.
Expanding these opportunities would help retain more of the state's
college graduates, bolstering the economy and alleviating workforce
shortages.

Despite the proven benefits of experiential learning, not all students
have access to these opportunities, and students from disadvantaged
backgrounds are the most likely to miss out. NACE research shows that
students who do not participate in experiential learning are less likely
to have job offers after graduation, thus perpetuating economic inequal-
ity. This legislation is necessary to ensure that all students at the
state university of New York and the city university of New York can
participate in experiential learning, enhancing their education and
preparing them for careers after college.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Establishes experiential learning opportunities in the state university of New York and the city university of New York.
